newsitem.title: UK: J.P.Morgan precious and base metals units merged.
newsitem.headline: J.P.Morgan precious and base metals units merged.

text.p: J.P.Morgan has merged its precious and base metals units, a spokesman for the bank said.
The merging of sales and trading units in base and precious metals into a single unit started last month, J.P.Morgan spokesman in Europe Joe Evangelisti confirmed to Reuters.
J.P.Morgan which trades precious metals and is prominent in options and futures business in copper and aluminium both in London Metal Exchange (LME) and Over-the-Counter (OTC) contracts.
On Thursday in response to questions Evangelisti said the U.S. bank was "totally committed to all aspects of the base and precious metals business".
There had been rumours amongst some LME traders that J.P.Morgan, a non-ring dealing clearing member of the LME, might wholly or partially withdraw from trading base metals.
